messages:
maria: Heads up — ap-southeast-1 GPU pool showing ~40% fewer nodes joined since 03:12 UTC. Apps are hitting capacity limits and falling back to eu-west.
ryan: Yep seeing it in the autoscaler logs: repeated node-join timeouts and `decrypt failed` from the node init logs.
sasha: I deployed the egress firewall tighten at ~03:05 to lock down audit exporters. Did we forget KMS allowlist? :grimacing:
maria: Logs show `KMS:AccessDenied` and `tcp reset` to kms.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com IP range. Seems the new deny rule is blocking STS/KMS egress from the GPU subnets.
ryan: Cost impact: traffic falling back to eu-west + warm pools there are spinning up — rough estimate +$4k/hr if this continues. alex: putting a quick cost watch on it. :money_with_wings:
sasha: Reverting the rule now. rolling back fw policy `egress-tighten-2026-03-21` in 3..2..1.
deploy-bot: rollback started for policy/egress-tighten-2026-03-21. Canary in ap-southeast-1 triggered.
maria: While rollback runs, can we short-term add a targeted allow for KMS and STS IPs? Prefer not to widen the ruleset.
security-bot: Recommend Privatelink for KMS, but short-term allowlist is acceptable for emergency. Logged as security finding #SEC-2026-013.
sasha: Adding temporary allow rules for outbound TCP 443 to kms endpoints and STS. Patch applied.
ryan: After patch I see node init decrypts succeeding. Example from node logs:
```
2026-03-21T03:18:49Z init: fetching key via KMS -> 200 OK
2026-03-21T03:18:50Z init: decrypt ok, attaching GPU driver
2026-03-21T03:19:12Z join: node joined pool-gpu-azb
```

maria: Gradual rejoin happening, warm pools draining fallback traffic back to apac. Observability: token-level latency spiked during the window, but QPS is normalizing.
alex: Cost watch: fallback compute is stopping, trending back down to baseline. Will send a short note to finance.
sasha: Follow-ups: 1) create a Privatelink request for KMS+STS in ap-southeast-1 2) add an egress test in canary pipeline that attempts KMS decrypt during fw changes 3) tighten allowlist TTL to 30m for emergency rules.
ryan: I'll open an incident ticket (INC-2026-045) to track RCA, cost impact, and postmortem. Assigned to infra-oncall.
maria: Putting the node-join playbook steps we ran here for the postmortem:
```
- check: `kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep NotReady`
- fetch init logs: `kubectl logs <init-pod>`
- grep for kms errors: `grep -E "KMS|decrypt" init.log`
- if firewall block, add temporary allowlist rule: `aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress ...` or revert rule
- monitor autoscaler: `prometheus:autoscaler.node_join_rate`
```

sasha: Thanks. I'll also annotate the fw PR with the test checklist so this doesn't slip again. :memo: 
ryan: Incident page up. adding timeline and links to logs.
deploy-bot: Canary rollback complete. No further rollout activity.
maria: Marking thread for postmortem. Quick win: automate KMS egress smoke test in the pipeline and raise Privatelink request.
alex: Noted. Sending cost summary in 30m.
security-bot: Flagging this as compliance-sensitive; we should schedule a design review for KMS Privatelink next week.
maria: Great — thanks everyone. Closing convo once INC-2026-045 has the postmortem link. :white_check_mark:
